about.title: Your Trusted Automotive Marketplace
about.p1: Salar Motors is a premium vehicle marketplace specializing in imported cars. We connect buyers with verified, quality vehicles sourced from Japan, America, Dubai, and beyond.
about.p2: Our platform is designed with transparency at its core. Every listing includes detailed specifications, clear pricing, and location information so you can compare options and make confident decisions without leaving the catalog.
about.p3: Whether you are looking for a reliable daily driver, a luxury import, or a family SUV, Salar Motors provides the tools and support to help you find exactly what you need.

whatIs.title: Afghanistan's Home For Imported Cars
whatIs.p1: Safar is a vehicle marketplace built for Afghanistan. We bring together imported cars from Japan, America, Dubai and beyond, so buyers can explore verified vehicles and cars already on their way — all in one place.
whatIs.p2: Every listing on Safar carries detailed specifications, clear pricing and location information. No guesswork, no hidden details compare options side by side and decide with confidence.
whatIs.p3: Whether you need a reliable daily driver, a luxury import or a family SUV, Safar connects you with the vehicle — and the people you can trust, from first search to final handover.
